deadlines.label: UCAS deadline (King's undergraduate courses)
deadlines.notes: 18:00 UK time. UCAS equal consideration date for 2027 entry. The King's course pages leave the application deadline field blank, so the UCAS date applies.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Nationals of listed majority English-speaking countries (including the U.S.A.) who completed a high school level 3 (A-level equivalent) qualification in a majority English-speaking country do not need an additional test; King's Foundations excepted. The requirement band depends on the course: band D (e.g. Computer Science) is the lowest undergraduate band shown here; Economics and General Engineering are band B.

english.notes: IELTS Academic, band D (e.g. Computer Science). Band B (Economics, General Engineering) is 7.0 overall and 6.5 in each skill. Test dated within two years of 1 Sept 2027.
Old 0-120 scale, tests taken before 21 Jan 2026, band D. Band B is 100 overall with 25 in writing and 23 in each other skill.
New 1-6 scale, tests taken from 21 Jan 2026, band D. Band B is 5 overall with 4.5 in each skill.
PTE Academic (UKVI version also accepted; PTE Online not accepted), band D. Band B is 69 with 62 in each skill.
Cambridge C1 Advanced or C2 Proficiency, band D. Band B is 185 overall with 176 in each skill.
Not on King's list of accepted tests; the page says a test that is not listed cannot be accepted.

tier_notes.general: Complete University Guide 2027 overall ranking: 16th of 130 UK universities (B = ranks 16-40 on the national scale).
